title: Hydrologic characterization of Bushy Park Reservoir, South Carolina, 2013–15
citation: Conrads, P.A., Petkewich, M.D., Falls, W.F., and Lanier, T.H., 2017, Hydrologic characterization of Bushy Park Reservoir, South Carolina, 2013–15: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Report SIR-2017-5050, map scale 1:96,775.
reader: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), scheduled Claude Code session 2026-10-04
notes:
Pages 1-43 (of 98). A surface-water report on Bushy Park Reservoir: study-area description, water use, continuous gaging network (table 3), meteorological data (wind, precipitation, PAR), water temperature, stage-area and index-velocity ratings, tunnel flow, and velocity profiling / mapping methods. It names no geologic units, borings, structures or aquifers, so no values are recorded. Gaging-station coordinates (table 3, page 24) are surface-water stations, not geologic observations. The only sediment remark is a migrating sand bar that buried the ADCP at site VVP5 with about 6 ft of sand (page 36), too general to record. The reference list is in the next packet.
Pages 44-98: reservoir hydrology and circulation discussion, velocity-mapping figures, summary, references, and appendixes 1-3 (wind and velocity rose diagrams, velocity-mapping plan views). No geologic units, borings, structures or aquifers are described, so only references are recorded. The reference list is printed in two columns that the text layer interleaves line by line; each quote is the opening of the entry and the citation value joins the entry's lines. Recorded: references about South Carolina waters (Bushy Park, Foster Creek, Cooper and Wando Rivers, Charleston Harbor, Santee-Cooper). Skipped general references: Downing and others 2001, Dzialowski and others 2009, Godin 1972, Homer and others 2015, Juttner and Watson 2007, Lanier and Conrads 2010 (Savannah River), Levesque and Oberg 2012, Mau and others 2004, NOAA 2013 and undated, Oberg and others 2005, Paerl and others 2001, Parsons and others 2013, Pidwirny 2011, Ruhl and Simpson 2005, Suffet and others 1996, Taylor and others 2006, USGS 1999, 2007, 2016, Wnorowski 1992, Young and others 1996.
